caption: The drawing consists of several stylized bird motifs and pottery outlines rendered in blue watercolor or ink on a beige background. At the top left and right corners, there are two outlined jars or canisters, each featuring a simple blue bird design on their surface. Below the jars, to the left, is a large bird with a long tail standing on a branch with small circles indicating berries or leaves. In the center of the composition is a round-bodied bird, also depicted in blue, pecking at a line of small circles that resemble berries or seeds. Beneath this bird is the outline of a jug or pitcher, which has a small floral or leaf motif and a blue bird design on its side. At the bottom right is another large bird in blue, perched on a branch with three stylized oval leaves. The entire composition is framed with a simple beige mat or border, and the drawing uses only shades of blue for the objects and black lines for outlines and details.
title: Bird Decorations on Stoneware
